content.text: Finance wants the checkout links we email to stop working eventually. Right now they never expire at all.

A hosted payment link is a signed token and today it carries no expiry, so a link we mint in March is still valid in December. Two questions have to be answered separately: how long the token should stay valid, and what the customer sees after it stops being valid. My suggestion is that we mint the token with a seven day window, and after it expires we land the customer on a page that offers to mint a fresh one rather than a bare 410.
Hosted links now carry a seven day expiry and a self-service re-issue path behind it.
